description: Start connecting this AI agent to InstantReply. Call this first if no other tools are available. Returns a short code and a link — tell the user to open the link, sign up or log in (takes under a minute), and approve the code. Then call check_setup.

persona.description: Who the user is, if you know it: creator (personal brand / Instagram DMs), business (sells products or services, has a website or WhatsApp), developer (building it into their own product), agency (running it for clients). Tailors their onboarding after they approve. Omit if unsure.

platform.description: Which channel the user wants to connect. Instagram needs no Meta review and works same-day; WhatsApp needs Meta Business Verification, which takes 2-6 weeks, so prefer instagram unless the user specifically needs WhatsApp.

name: start_setup
